direction.camera: Guide attention with fashion crop; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: offset a close crop against an assertive editorial headline; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with asymmetric margin; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with editorial pose.
direction.lighting: large fashion key; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: woven textile and satin trim; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around textile depth; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use fashion crop,asymmetric margin,serif headline,confident cut,textile depth,editorial pose as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
